title: Teach where the work is taken seriously
lead: We are looking for teachers who go beyond the syllabus — the ones who stay back for the student who has not understood, and who have something ready for the student who has raced ahead.
intro: New Apostolic English High School and Dr. Bower Apostolic Junior College employ teaching and non-teaching staff across Pre-Primary, Primary, High School, Junior College and our degree programmes.

What we offer is a small institution where your work is visible: classes you keep for years, colleagues who know your students, and a management that expects you to be given the time to teach properly.

whyJoin.title: Classes you keep
whyJoin.description: Teachers stay with a cohort long enough to see the effect of their own work.

whyJoin.title: Resources that get used
whyJoin.description: Laboratories, smart classrooms and workshop equipment are in the timetable, not in a cupboard.

whyJoin.title: A stated ethic
whyJoin.description: Love thy neighbour as thyself is the standard for how staff are treated too.

whyJoin.title: Room to grow
whyJoin.description: Section responsibility, examination coordination and programme leadership are filled from within.

openings.title: Mathematics Teacher
openings.summary: To teach mathematics across the middle and high school, with responsibility for Class X board preparation.
responsibilities: Teach mathematics to assigned classes across Grades VI to X following the Maharashtra State Board syllabus.
Plan and deliver lessons that build understanding through worked problems rather than demonstration alone.
Set, mark and record continuous assessment, unit tests and terminal examinations.
Run structured revision and past-paper practice for Class X, with additional support and extension sessions.
Meet parents at scheduled parent–teacher meetings and communicate concerns early.

openings.title: Pre-Primary Teacher
openings.experience: 1+ year, or a strong NTT/ECCE qualification
openings.qualification: Graduate with NTT / ECCE / Montessori training
openings.summary: To teach a Nursery, LKG or UKG class, with responsibility for early language, numeracy and settling in.
responsibilities: Plan and run a structured but flexible day of phonics, early numeracy, craft, rhyme and free play.
Bring every child to a working level of spoken English regardless of their starting point.
Maintain daily observation records and share progress with parents.
Work alongside the section attendants to keep the section safe, calm and well supervised.

openings.title: Computer Science Lecturer
openings.experience: 3+ years teaching at Junior College or degree level
openings.summary: To teach Information Technology at Junior College and applied papers on the BCCA programme.
responsibilities: Teach Information Technology for Grades XI and XII and applied papers on the BCCA degree programme.
Supervise practical sessions in the computer laboratory and maintain journal standards through the year.
Support the school's robotics workshops for high school classes.
Guide students on project work, and advise senior students on progression into computing courses.

openings.title: Physical Education Teacher
openings.summary: To run timetabled physical education across the school and coach the inter-school teams.
responsibilities: Deliver timetabled physical education for every grade, adapted by age and ability.
Coach school teams across throwball, volleyball, basketball, athletics and indoor disciplines.
Plan and run the inter-house programme and the annual Apostolic Sports meet.
Maintain equipment, and enforce safety procedure on the ground and in the gymnasium.

howToApply: Complete the application form on this page, attaching a link to your CV if you have one online.
Alternatively, download the printable application form and submit it at the school office.
Shortlisted candidates are invited for a demonstration lesson with a live class, followed by an interview with the Principal.
References are taken up before an offer is confirmed.
